evidence.notes: Local Database.getDeleted returns records deleted inside the requested sync window.
DeletedRecord exposes the deleted local record Id.
DeletedRecord exposes the local deletion Date.

source.content: Datetime windowStart = Datetime.now().addMinutes(-1); Account account = new Account(Name = 'Delete Me'); insert account; Id accountId = account.Id; delete account; Datetime windowEnd = Datetime.now().addMinutes(1); Database.GetDeletedResult observed = Database.getDeleted('Account', windowStart, windowEnd); Database.DeletedRecord deleted; for (Database.DeletedRecord candidate : observed.getDeletedRecords()) { if (candidate.getId() == accountId) { deleted = candidate; break; } } System.assertNotEquals(null, deleted); System.assertEquals(accountId, deleted.getId()); System.assertEquals(Date.today(), deleted.getDeletedDate());
